many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

True /home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545726/attempts/1215c664ab1d474cb6ca911ca8ae1318/system/state/workspace/programs/task-abe77ffb.py
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
    col_sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0)
    left = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
